summary: This note describes Irkutsky District, one of the thirty-three administrative districts of Irkutsk Oblast in Russia. It is located in the south of the oblast and is incorporated municipally as Irkutsky Municipal District. Its administrative center is the city of Irkutsk, which is not administratively part of the district; the district had a population of 84,322 at the 2010 Census.
one_line: Irkutsky District is one of thirty-three districts in Irkutsk Oblast, Russia, centered on but excluding the city of Irkutsk.
key_facts: Irkutsky District is one of the thirty-three administrative districts in Irkutsk Oblast, Russia.
Municipally, Irkutsky District is incorporated as Irkutsky Municipal District.
Irkutsky District is located in the south of Irkutsk Oblast.
The administrative center of Irkutsky District is the city of Irkutsk.
The city of Irkutsk is not administratively a part of Irkutsky District.
As of the 2010 Census, the total population of Irkutsky District was 84,322.
